correctness.rationale: For every real 2/3<beta<3/4, the n=0 and n=±1 Janssen–Ron–Shen fiber identities force the pointwise costs beta on outer fibers and 2beta on a middle interval of length 1-2(delta), delta=1/beta-1. Integration yields 4beta-2; support counting yields 4-2/beta. Equality in triangle inequalities determines every complex-valued minimizer. Each constructed bounded compactly supported fiber is Bessel, satisfies n=0,±1, and its n=±2 collisions are excluded by delta>1/3; |n|>=3 vanish by support. Exact-rational standalone tests passed for 59 parameter choices and 26532 correlation checks. Computations supplement and do not replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: This resolves a natural first post-2/3 alias phase for the established dual-Gabor L1 localization problem, where two off-diagonal constraints simultaneously force a nonzero dual tail. It gives two exact optimal objective functions on a continuum of sampling densities and all complex L1 and minimum-support extremizers, quantitatively describing how minimum sparsity grows after the known 2/3 threshold. A sharp closed family and equality geometry are useful beyond the generic unsolved finite LP formulation; no claims are made for other windows or later density phases.
